item.title: v3.4.0 — One switch per MCP client, a --mcp-stdio mode, and a stable MCP port
item.description: Five clients — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and WorkBuddy — get one switch each. Flipping it writes only the mcpServers.kaidoplan key into that client's config and leaves the rest of the file byte-identical. The app binary can run as a stdio MCP server with --mcp-stdio, so a client can start it without a separate CLI install. The MCP service is now on by default, and the bound port is persisted across launches with a 56-port fallback range.
